cleavage_agent.evidence: deglycosylated with PNGaseF (2000 U, New England BioLabs, Ipswich, MA) for 2 h under agitation at 37°C, followed by digestion with Lys-C (Wako Chemicals USA, Richmond, VA), at a ratio of 1:100 enzyme:substrate, under agitation at 37°C for 2 h.
